features: 5.1CH Surround Sound: Feel powerful 5.1ch Surround Sound, uniquely shaped to reduce distortion.
Power Output: Cinematic Surround Sound and Powerful bass effect with 1000w Power Ouput.

Powerful Sound: Pure power, soundbar, subwoofer, and rear speakers work in harmony to deliver booming bass, soaring highs, and an energetic, immersive sound experience that’s nothing short of thrilling
Dolby Atmos/DTS x: Get the best streaming experience with support for Dolby Atmos and DTS:X.
Clear dialogue: Crystal clear dialogue, even in the action. From quiet whispers to thundering action, voices come through crisp and clear, so you stay fully immersed without missing a line.
Easy setup and operation: The BRAVIA Connect smartphone app guides you through initial settings, assists with troubleshooting, and lets you control volume, sound field and more.

Environment and Accessibility: We're accelerating our accessibility initiatives, enabling people who are blind or deaf to use Sony’s devices, and expanding our environmental initiatives by incorporating recycled plastic into our products.
Room Filling Sound: Multi Stereo enhances your listening experience by playing the same sound from all speakers, creating a room-filling sound boost.
